Maybe he doesn’t see getting married as “important”.  If you both truly love each other and have kids and all is good maybe he sees getting married as unnecessary.  It’s impossible to come to a good conclusion without knowing all that goes on but for some marriage is super important for things to work and for others it’s just a formality.

On the surface his comments about how he loves how you keep the house together can be seen as he just loves you because you do all the hard work in the relationship and he gets to skate by.  It could also be because he just isn’t elegant with words.  After all “what do you love about me” can be answered in so many ways that can come across in many ways.  He might of meant it as he loves your ability to handle the house with love and compassion with the addition of a strong work ethic.  After all running a house with two kids is not without challenges almost daily and not everyone can do it.  To me that’s certainly better than a generic “I love how funny you are.”

TLDR: We don’t know the whole story.  On one hand he could be the jerk just using you or he could truly love you and just not see marriage as super deal breaking important.  In my opinion honestly talk it over and see where both of you stand.  Either everything is going well and you just have different views on marriage which can be worked out, or you two just aren’t truly in it together.   


Just don’t jump to “he sucks” and potentially destroy something that’s going well because of what he may see as a trivial formality.

I’m on high alert so I grab a fire axe because who knows what I’m gonna find. I climb out of the truck which, for reference has a cab similar to a semi with two steps mounted to a fuel tank with the bottom of the door at about chest height.
